title: 第九章 一梦十年第十章 大小废物
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 【三玄冰封阵】是一种基础守护阵法，没有什么附加功效，就是单纯地立起一道冰壳子防止外人进入。
优点是布阵所需材料不金贵，而且稳定易成，套在其他法阵之内使用不容易被阵内灵场影响崩坏；而缺点则是，这阵法是一次性的，布阵者修为再高用此法生成的阵法也就只能挡住结丹期的修士了。
但这对于解清玄来说足够了，而且这种阵法也是她唯一可以速成学会的阵法，她也没得选。
做好防御，解清玄终于再次安心下来，先躺在石床上睡了个安稳觉。
这穿越来的一个多月啊，她真的是陀螺一样的连轴转，熬了无数个通宵，没睡上一个好觉！
洞中无日月，一梦不知年。
从冰冷的石床上醒来，解清玄只觉得腰酸背痛，浑身僵硬。
这tm石床真不是给人睡的啊！她还不如在地上找块苔藓躺着睡呢！
她寻思自己初来此世时那浑身痛到抽搐的体感可能也不全是灵根炸裂造成的，多半也要赖这石床太硌人！
罢了，反正现在是不困了。
解清玄觉得自己精神状态良好，便又拿起书，心无旁骛地一本一本地学起来。
她就这么边学法术，边练心法、吐纳，巩固修为，也不知怎么地在某一天忽然就入了定。
这日，碧空之下突现百里异样灵光。
一座峭山山顶洞中传出一阵闷雷，雷震惊起片片飞鸟，那声势之大仿佛要将整座山都劈开似的，连带着整座峭山随之颤抖。
山洞之中，狭小的空间内由解清玄灵根处散发出的浓郁灵力相互摩擦碰撞，就像乌云中擦出闪电般爆发出一阵阵强烈灵光！
就在那灵光盛无可盛之时便【嘭】的一声向上击穿了洞顶，一道闪电由下而上直冲云霄！
身体上的疼痛是小，可解清玄的灵魂仿佛是要被这雷劫磨碎了般的痛苦。有那么一瞬间她甚至觉得自己又要人生再开了。
不知过了多久，那狂暴的灵力终于渐渐平息。
解清玄僵僵挨过了这骇人雷劫缓缓从识海中归来。
她抬头一看，自己修炼的洞府已经被天雷砸成了露台。
外面天光正好一碧如洗，偶有几行大雁飞过，仿佛方才那惊天动地的骇人雷劫只存在于自己的幻想。
洞内【三玄冰封阵】已碎，透亮的冰壳片片碎裂坠落，在空中化作一阵“钻石雨”。
解清玄一挥手便将漫天冰晶粉尘化作灵气清扫干净，又念头微动，施法补全了被雷劫损坏的【云水守阵】。
如今她对这洞内的法术阵法和流云宗的基础法术已经用的得心应手、游刃有余。
做完洞府的维护修补，她伸出手，活动了一下僵硬的四肢，只觉神清气爽。
她就这么莫名其妙，又自然而然的突破元婴境界了。
也不知她具体闭关了多久，应当是超过她预计中的三个月了。
不过她也没看到传音玉符中有叶问秋的留言，他既然没来催她干活儿，那她是不是可以再在洞府中苟上几天，多学多练一些实用法术？
“恭喜师尊晋升元婴！”
解清玄还在纠结，却忽听洞外传来个陌生又熟悉的声音，随后她纳戒中的传音玉符也多了条留言。
她暂时未去管传音玉符，先迎出洞府去看了那恭贺之人是谁。
她神识先至，随后本人也缓缓走出。
content_en:
[Three Mysterious Ice Formation] is a basic protective formation with no additional effects. It simply erects an ice shell to prevent outsiders from entering.
The advantage is that the materials needed to set up the formation are not expensive, and are stable and easy to make. When used in other magic formations, they will not be easily destroyed by the influence of the spiritual field in the formation. The disadvantage is that this formation is a one-time use. No matter how high the cultivation level of the person who set up the formation is, the formation generated by this method can only block monks in the elixir formation stage.
But this was enough for Jie Qingxuan, and this formation was the only one she could learn quickly, so she had no choice.
With good defense, Xie Qingxuan finally felt at ease again and lay down on the stone bed for a peaceful sleep.
During the more than a month since she traveled back in time, she was really spinning like a top. She stayed up for countless all-nighters and didn't get a good night's sleep!
There is no sun or moon in the cave, and the year is unknown in a dream.
Waking up from the cold stone bed, Xie Qingxuan felt only pain in his back and stiffness all over.
This stone bed is really not for people to sleep on! She might as well find a piece of moss on the ground and lie down to sleep!
She thought that when she first came to this world, the pain and twitching all over her body might not be entirely caused by the explosion of her spiritual roots. It was probably also caused by the stone bed being too harsh!
That's all, I'm not sleepy now anyway.
Xie Qingxuan felt that he was in good spirits, so he picked up the book again and started studying one by one without any distractions.
She just learned spells, practiced mental techniques, breathed out, and consolidated her cultivation. Somehow, she suddenly fell into trance one day.
On this day, a strange aura suddenly appeared under the blue sky.
A burst of muffled thunder came from a cave on the top of a steep mountain. The thunder shocked the birds. The sound was so loud that it seemed as if it was going to split the entire mountain, causing the entire steep mountain to tremble.
In the cave, the rich spiritual power emitted from the Jie Qingxuan Spiritual Root in the small space rubbed and collided with each other, bursts of intense spiritual light erupted like lightning in the dark clouds!
Just when the spiritual light was at its peak, a "bang" sound penetrated upwards through the roof of the cave, and a bolt of lightning shot straight into the sky from bottom to top!
The physical pain was small, but Jie Qingxuan's soul felt as if it was going to be ground to pieces by this thunderstorm. For a moment, she even felt that she was about to start her life again.
After an unknown amount of time, the violent spiritual power finally subsided.
Jie Qingxuan Zhuangzheng survived this terrifying thunderstorm and slowly returned from the sea of ​​consciousness.
She looked up and saw that the cave where she practiced had been turned into a terrace by thunder.
The sky outside was bright and clear, and occasionally a few rows of wild geese flew by, as if the terrifying thunderstorm that shook the earth just now existed only in my own imagination.
The [Three Mysterious Ice Array] in the cave was broken, and the translucent ice shell fragments fell into pieces, turning into a "rain of diamonds" in the air.
Xie Qingxuan waved his hand and turned the ice crystal dust in the sky into spiritual energy to clean up. With a slight thought, he cast a spell to repair the [Yunshui Defense Formation] damaged by the thunderstorm.
Now she has mastered the spell formations in the cave and the basic spells of Liuyun Sect with ease.
After finishing the maintenance and repair of the cave, she stretched out her hand and moved her stiff limbs, feeling refreshed.
She was able to break through the Nascent Soul realm so inexplicably and naturally.
I don’t know how long she has been in seclusion for, but it should be more than the three months she expected.
However, she didn't see Ye Wenqiu's message in the sound transmission jade talisman. Since he didn't come to urge her to work, could she stay in the cave for a few more days and learn more and practice more practical spells?
"Congratulations, Master, for being promoted to Nascent Soul!"
Xie Qingxuan was still struggling, but suddenly she heard a strange and familiar voice coming from outside the cave, and then there was an additional message on the sound transmission jade talisman in her ring.
She ignored the sound transmission jade talisman for the time being and welcomed him out of the cave to see who the congratulator was.
Her consciousness arrived first, and then she walked out slowly.
